content.comment_body: Hi, I was attempting to configure my [product_name] [article_no] for integration with a touch panel. During the upload of the program from my computer to the controller, something malfunctioned—the controller began repeatedly rebooting. Power cycling didn’t resolve the problem. I also disconnected the analog output module, but the issue persisted. Everything is powered by 24VDC through a compatible power module and the display seems operational. Using a different power source didn’t help. I was working on a non-conductive surface and the system wasn’t connected to any external inputs/outputs. Previously, the same setup worked fine. I’m using [product_name] programming software [version_no]. Any suggestions?
What exactly went wrong during the upload? Was there a power failure or an interruption in the connection between the PC and the controller?
Try deleting the program on the controller. Go to Tools > Transfer > delete user program and password, then attempt to transfer the program again.
I’m unable to connect to the [article_no]—it keeps rebooting continuously (see attached video).
Is there an SD card installed in the controller?

I’m not sure what caused the issue; I just added a server connection in the configuration software and uploaded the revised program to the controller. As usual, I got the connection status and commands to stop the device. After clicking to stop, uploading the program, and starting the device, it entered an endless reboot loop.
No, I haven’t used an SD card in this device yet.
Is there a hidden emergency reset button—like the ones found in smartphones that require a sharp object to activate? Maybe [article_no] has something similar?
I’m not aware of such a feature.
It’s possible I accidentally pressed "start" for the controller program both on the physical keypad and in the programming software.
It’s likely the analog module isn’t properly locked onto the base unit [article_no]. Try pressing down with a screwdriver to secure the lock on the unit.
That doesn’t make a difference—I’ve already tried it. In the video, the module is completely disconnected and only powered. The device is still under warranty, so we plan to exchange it.

analysis.insight_summary: Users encountered a persistent reboot problem with a [product_name] controller module while configuring and updating its program through [product_name] programming software. The issue arose during a standard upload, resulting in loss of functionality, with unsuccessful recovery attempts including power cycling and removal of expansion modules. Users expressed concern about the lack of an emergency reset option and uncertainty about software-hardware interactions during such failures.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect reliable program upload and recovery processes, a clear way to reset devices in case of major errors, and informative diagnostics to aid troubleshooting. Guidance on correct program transfer procedures and expected device behavior would be helpful.
